\caption{\bt{\system\ architecture. Learning path (1--3): the answer provenance of agent A's judged tasks is extracted into candidates, which are published after admission checks G1--G7. Use path (4--7): a lookup compares dependency versions and returns the current valid revision $m^r$; condition maintenance reuses check results keyed by each condition's canonical form and dependency versions, runs only the remaining checks, and repairs failed definitions only with a unique filter that passes the regression test (G8). Execution path (8--9): a query that declares $m^r$ is checked against its conditions on its own snapshot and executed on that snapshot.}{\system\ 架构。学习路径（1--3）：智能体 A 判题成功任务的答案溯源被提取为候选，通过准入检查 G1--G7 后发布。使用路径（4--7）：查找比较依赖版本，返回当前有效修订 $m^r$；条件维护按条件的规范形式与依赖版本复用检查结果，只执行其余检查，并只用通过回归测试（G8）的唯一过滤修复条件失败的定义。执行路径（8--9）：声明 $m^r$ 的查询在自身快照上核对其条件，并在该快照上执行。}}
\label{fig:architecture}
\Description{Agents on top: agent A and an LLM extractor on the left, agents B, C, and D on the right. In the MAVRA middleware, admission with admission checks G1--G7 on the left publishes into a central shared store of definitions and check results; condition maintenance and bounded repair with regression test G8 sit below the store and write back into it; lookup and same-snapshot validation on the right read from the store, and the revision returned by the lookup is the one the query declares. A version tracker feeds table versions $V(T)$ to the lookup. A SQL database at the bottom holds tables, whose rows changed by ETL writers raise their versions, the versions themselves, and the snapshot $D_s$ on which same-snapshot validation checks every condition of $m^r$ and runs the query. Step numbers 1--9 and arrows are colored by learning, use, and execution path; thick arrows write the shared store and dashed arrows read database state.}
